cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: What Rule Did I Miss?
cards.instruction: Find the hidden rule that makes the strange situation consistent, practical, or at least survivable.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Your shadow moved before you. What changed?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was thinking of leaving, but I can't find the exit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Think about that bench without moving. Does it turn?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's gone to the bench. I'm still here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It seems to follow your intentions. Think about the exit again; let's follow slowly and see whether it knows the way.

mechanism: A directs intention tests and cautious movement to infer a useful rule for an independently moving shadow.
confusable: Unlike treating the shadow as a random omen, A tests a specific intention hypothesis and applies it to finding an exit.
comparison: Finding a way out with a shadow differs from directing soup with a utensil.
seedUse: The seed already assigns the bench test and directs slow following, so S01 shapes the practical inquiry.
